name: usb_host_uac
description: Espressif USB Host UAC driver (esp-usb host/class/uac/usb_host_uac, commit 68bf7f9, Apache-2.0), vendored because the Arduino build has no IDF component manager. Its Kconfig values (CONFIG_UAC_*) are global build_flags in platformio.ini, because uac.h sizes structs with them.
